title_sq: Apartament 2+1 per shitje te Tregu Elektrik
description_sq:
Ofrojme apartament per shitje ne zonen e tregut elektrik, tek Kompleksi 'Grand'.
Pozicionohet ne katin e 7 banim, kompleks i ri me ashensor dhe i mirembajtur.
Tipologjia e apartamentit eshte 2+1, me hapesira te bollshme, te organizuara ne nje dhome ndenjeje, kuzhina, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe 2 ballkone.
Prona ofron nje mobilim te plote dhe komfort.
Orintimi Jug-Perendim i apartamentit i jep ndricim natyral pergjate dites.
Kompleksi dhe zona perreth ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode.
Per detaje shtese mos hezitoni te na kontaktoni!
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in Tregu Elektrik
description_en: We offer an apartment for sale in the electrical market area, in the 'Grand' Complex. It is located on the 7th residential floor, new complex with elevator and well maintained. The typology of the apartment is 2+1, with ample spaces, organized in a living room, kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 2 balconies. The property offers a complete furnishing and comfort. The South-West orientation of the apartment provides natural lighting throughout the day. The complex and the surrounding area offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life. For additional details, do not hesitate to contact us!
